config.fixturePreparation: Original strict v2 B5 archived package imported through the native v3 UI as a complete independent migrated copy; migration is excluded from selection timing.
config.processState: Fresh dedicated headless Chrome process/profile per case/run; HTTP cache disabled; OS caches not purged. caffeinate -i prevents idle sleep, not lid-closure sleep; keep the laptop lid open during measurements.
config.interruptionDetection: A Node event-loop wall gap over 5 seconds invalidates the run as an environment interruption. Browser Date/performance clock discontinuities over 250ms also invalidate the sample. These detect tool/host suspension, not slow product work on the separate renderer process; slow product samples are retained.
config.method: Real member-mode contained marquee from 100mm inside top-left to 100mm inside bottom-right, eight rAF-paced pointer moves; alternate each with one real marker click. Pointerup capture starts response timing, document bubble follows React handler, MutationObserver requires expected selectedIds and inspector, then two rAF callbacks. All samples and slow observations retained.
config.correctness: Each run calibrates stable actual ID order; prop membership is independently checked against rotated visual corners and fixture entity/container locks. Complete UI package bytes/content, raw IndexedDB stores, revision/save state and base-render count checked before/after. When exposed, initial viewport refinement finishes and stabilizes for 320ms in setup; per-sample and whole-window refinement counts must remain unchanged.
limitations: Selection DOM readiness is a scheduling/commit proxy, not a direct Canvas drawing boundary or GPU completion.
Canvas, React and product functions are not wrapped. Formal runs do not use CPU profiler.
LongTask entries cover main-thread tasks over 50ms and can span multiple phases; no function-level attribution is inferred.
Pointer event timestamps omit physical/OS input latency. rAF intervals contain browser/automation/observer scheduling.
Before/after IndexedDB equality does not prove no transient writes occurred.
Calibrated structural IDs are checked for stability, not independently geometry-audited here.
No complete QA-PERF-01/04, resource peak, cross-browser or physical presentation claim.
